reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 32 original B1/B2 noun exercises: checked full German sentences, every offered option, grammatical forms, accepted answers, distinct contexts and bilingual feedback. Deferred regional Brötli and Bub and B2-level Brett. No inherited examples copied; independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending.
